summary: Nuran Wireless Inc. filed a Form 6-K with an exhibit containing its executive compensation disclosure for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2025, prepared under Canadian National Instrument 51-102. The filing is a routine regulatory disclosure of salaries for the CEO (C$175,000) and CFO (C$157,566), with no bonuses, perquisites, or special arrangements noted. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or management change is present. The filing is purely informational and procedural, reflecting standard continuous disclosure obligations for a foreign private issuer.
